2608.27110.title: DocTalkBN: A Novel Dataset of Expert Telemedicine Conversations in Bengali
2608.27110.paper_summary: Reliable medical conversational AI requires authentic expert--patient interaction data, yet such datasets remain scarce, especially for low-resource languages such as Bengali. We present DocTalkBN, a large-scale multimodal dataset of real-world expert telemedicine conversations in Bengali, collected from nationally broadcast telemedicine programs featuring board-certified physicians. DocTalkBN contains 557.63 hours of paired audio and text, 1,515 multi-turn patient calls, 10,274 host--doctor question--answer exchanges, totaling 1.7M tokens, spanning 26 medical specialties. Unlike prior resources derived from medical forums, written health content, or synthetic data, our dataset preserves the spontaneity, contextual richness, and spoken characteristics of authentic medical interactions in a low-resource setting. To support benchmark-driven research, we further construct three downstream tasks from the corpus, medical triage classification, advice safety evaluation, and medical named entity recognition, and benchmark a diverse set of large language models and encoder-based baselines. Our results show that DocTalkBN is a practically useful resource, particularly for clinically grounded reasoning tasks. We release this resource to facilitate future research on reliable medical NLP and safer, more culturally grounded healthcare systems for low-resource languages. Our source codes and dataset are publicly available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/doctalk.
2608.27110.paper_summary_zh: 可靠的醫療對話AI需要真實的專家與病人互動數據，但這類數據集仍然稀缺，尤其是對於像孟加拉語這樣的低資源語言。我們提出了DocTalkBN，一個大規模的多模態數據集，包含來自全國廣播的孟加拉語專家遠程醫療對話，這些對話由持有董事會認證的醫生進行。DocTalkBN包含557.63小時的配對音頻和文本、1,515個多輪病人來電、10,274個主持人與醫生的問答交流，總計1.7M個標記，涵蓋26個醫學專科。與以往從醫療論壇、書面健康內容或合成數據中衍生的資源不同，我們的數據集保留了低資源環境中真實醫療互動的自發性、上下文豐富性和口語特徵。為了支持基準驅動的研究，我們進一步從語料庫構建了三個下游任務，包括醫療分診分類、建議安全評估和醫療命名實體識別，並對一組多樣的大型語言模型和基於編碼器的基準進行基準測試。我們的結果顯示，DocTalkBN是一個實用的資源，特別是對於臨床基礎的推理任務。我們釋放這一資源以促進未來在可靠醫療NLP和更安全、更具文化根基的低資源語言醫療系統方面的研究。我們的源代碼和數據集已在https://anonymous.4open.science/r/doctalk上公開。
